result_text:
I fixed the patterns for all four default conventions. The tests I ran passed (`-Dtest='*Convention*'` in `codeanalyzer`), but I didn't add tests for the new cases, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML, `app.js` and `build-gradle.js` matches are untested.

In `GeneratedConventions.java`:
- The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator HTML rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- The .NET assembly documentation rule used `.*/[.]xml`, which only matched a file named `.xml`. It is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- The `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule had the same problem with `.*/[.]js`. It is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.

In `BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`, the Gradle JavaScript rule `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so any `*-gradle.js` file matches.

The old matches (Doxygen `.html`, `.xhtml` with a generator tag, `build.gradle`) are untouched. The XML and JS rules still require their content line, so ordinary hand-written `.xml` and `.js` files stay out of the generated scope. The same holds for `.htm` files without a generator marker.
